description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing a period in a loan schedule, including various financial attributes such as principal, interest, fees, penalties, and totals, with several static factory methods for creating instances for specific types of periods.

classes.name: LoanSchedulePeriodData
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating all details of a specific loan repayment period, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, and total amounts, along with multiple factory methods for creating different period types.

methods.name: disbursementOnlyPeriod
methods.description: Creates a LoanSchedulePeriodData instance representing a disbursement-only period, setting relevant dates and amounts, typically at loan disbursement.

methods.name: repaymentOnlyPeriod
methods.description: Creates a LoanSchedulePeriodData for a repayment period with specified principal, interest, fees, and penalties due.

methods.name: downPaymentOnlyPeriod
methods.description: Creates a period representing a down payment, with principal due at a specific date.

methods.name: periodWithPayments
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive period record with detailed payments, outstanding amounts, and other financial metrics.

methods.name: withPaidDetail
methods.description: Returns a new LoanSchedulePeriodData instance with updated paid amounts, recalculated outstanding balances, and status.
